text.p: LaserVision Centers Inc said Wednesday it completed a $1.5 million transaction for financing of several of its Visx excimer lasers through the Technology Finance Division of Transamerica Business Credit.
The company said it is eligible to receive additional funding based on agreed performance criteria.
Chairman John Klobnak said the funds would go toward general corporate purposes in conjunction with the company's plans to continue its U.S. expansion program.
LaserVision has agreements to serve 50 sites in 25 states. Klobnak said reports that the company would open an estimated additional 60 sites within the next 12 months are "achievable."
Klobnak said March was the best month so far for surgical case volume in the United States, increasing 15 percent over February, the company's previous best month.
The excimer laser is a device which allows eye surgeons to correct nearsightedness with an outpatient procedure that usually lasts less than one minute.
